# Interaction patterns

This compatibility topic remains hidden from the default book navigation. The existing skills own these interaction contracts.

## Introduction

Follow the relevant owner rather than maintaining a second interaction specification:

- [Hover](../../hover/SKILL.md) for timing, anchoring, keyboard access, and dismissal.
- [Context menus](../../context-menus/SKILL.md) for action grouping, order, and labels.
- [Accessibility](../../accessibility/SKILL.md) for keyboard navigation, focus, and assistive-technology support.
